+services:
+  logstash:
+    build:
+      context: .
+      # MaxMind credentials passed as BuildKit secrets (mounted into the build,
+      # never written to image layers or build logs). Required for ingest-time
+      # geo / ASN enrichment; leave the env vars blank in .env to skip.
+      secrets:
+        - maxmind_account_id
+        - maxmind_license_key
+    image: unifi-syslog-logstash:local
+    container_name: unifi-syslog-logstash
+    restart: unless-stopped
+    networks:
+      # Replace this network name + ipv4_address with whatever macvlan network
+      # you've created on the host (see README). The container needs its own
+      # IP so it can bind port 514 without clashing with the host's syslog.
+      syslog-net:
+        ipv4_address: 10.0.0.21

discussion_comments.comment_body:
Fixed in c7adcd10be. Rewrote `docker-compose.yml` for portability: default now uses Docker's built-in bridge network + `ports:` publishing (`- "514:514/udp"` and `- "514:514/tcp"`) which works out of the box on any Docker host. Removed the hardcoded `10.0.0.21` IP and the external `syslog-net` network requirement from the default.

The macvlan/dedicated-IP pattern is preserved as a **commented optional section at the bottom of the file** for advanced deployments — e.g. hosts already running rsyslog on 514, or UniFi devices that prefer target-discovery on-LAN. Fully documented with the `docker network create -d macvlan ...` command needed.

+Description: |
+  This ASIM filtering parser normalizes Palo Alto Prisma Cloud Compute management audit login events from the Syslog table and supports Authentication schema filters for time, source IP, source hostname, username, target application, event type, result, and result details.
+  This parser was created using the agentic ASIM parser creation tool, powered by Skills in GitHub.
+ParserName: vimAuthenticationPaloAltoPrismaCloud
+EquivalentBuiltInParser: _Im_Authentication_PaloAltoPrismaCloud
+ParserParams:
+  - Name: starttime
+    Type: datetime
+    Default: datetime(null)
+  - Name: endtime
+    Type: datetime
+    Default: datetime(null)
+  - Name: username_has_any
+    Type: dynamic
+    Default: dynamic([])
+  - Name: targetappname_has_any
+    Type: dynamic
+    Default: dynamic([])
+  - Name: srcipaddr_has_any_prefix
+    Type: dynamic
+    Default: dynamic([])
+  - Name: srchostname_has_any
+    Type: dynamic
+    Default: dynamic([])
+  - Name: eventtype_in
+    Type: dynamic
+    Default: dynamic([])
+  - Name: eventresultdetails_in
+    Type: dynamic
+    Default: dynamic([])
+  - Name: eventresult
+    Type: string
+    Default: '*'
+  - Name: disabled
+    Type: bool
+    Default: false
+  - Name: pack
+    Type: bool
+    Default: false
+ParserQuery: |
+  let parser = (
+      starttime: datetime = datetime(null),
+      endtime: datetime = datetime(null),
+      srcipaddr_has_any_prefix: dynamic = dynamic([]),
+      srchostname_has_any: dynamic = dynamic([]),
+      username_has_any: dynamic = dynamic([]),
+      targetappname_has_any: dynamic = dynamic([]),
+      eventtype_in: dynamic = dynamic([]),
+      eventresult: string = "*",
+      eventresultdetails_in: dynamic = dynamic([]),
+      disabled: bool = false,
+      pack: bool = false
+  ) {
+  Syslog
+  | where not(disabled)
+      and (isnull(starttime) or TimeGenerated >= starttime)
+      and (isnull(endtime) or TimeGenerated <= endtime)
+      and (array_length(username_has_any) == 0 or SyslogMessage has_any (username_has_any))
+      and (array_length(targetappname_has_any) == 0 or "Prisma Cloud Compute" has_any (targetappname_has_any))
+      and (array_length(srchostname_has_any) == 0)
+      and (array_length(eventtype_in) == 0 or "Logon" in~ (eventtype_in))
+  | where ProcessName == "Twistlock-Console"
+  | parse-kv SyslogMessage as (
+      ['time']:string,
+      ['type']:string,
+      id:string,
+      log_type:string,
+      username:string,
+      source_ip:string,
+      api:string,
+      status:string
+  )
+  with (pair_delimiter=' ', kv_delimiter='=', quote='"')
+  | where ['type'] == "management_audit" and log_type == "login"
+  | where (array_length(username_has_any) == 0 or username in~ (username_has_any))
+      and (array_length(srcipaddr_has_any_prefix) == 0 or has_any_ipv4_prefix(source_ip, srcipaddr_has_any_prefix))
+  | extend
+      EventStartTime = coalesce(todatetime(['time']), EventTime),
+      EventEndTime = coalesce(todatetime(['time']), EventTime),
+      EventResult = case(
+          status == "successful login attempt", "Success",
+          status in ("invalid credentials", "expired token"), "Failure",
+          "NA"
+      ),
+      EventResultDetails = case(
+          status == "invalid credentials", "No such user or password",
+          status == "expired token", "Session expired",
+          ""
+      ),
+      EventSeverity = case(
+          SeverityLevel =~ "info", "Informational",
+          SeverityLevel =~ "warning", "Medium",
+          SeverityLevel =~ "error", "High",
+          SeverityLevel =~ "critical", "High",
+          "Informational"
+      ),
+      SrcIpAddr = iff(isnotnull(parse_ipv4(source_ip)), source_ip, ""),
+      DvcIpAddr = iff(isnotnull(parse_ipv4(HostIP)), HostIP, ""),
+      DvcId = _ResourceId,
+      DvcIdType = iff(isnotempty(_ResourceId), "AzureResourceId", ""),
+      TargetUsername = username,
+      TargetUsernameType = iff(isnotempty(username), "Simple", ""),
+      TargetAppName = "Prisma Cloud Compute",
+      TargetAppType = "Service",
+      EventUid = hash_sha256(strcat(TenantId, EventTime, SyslogMessage))
+  | where (eventresult == "*" or EventResult == eventresult)
+      and (array_length(eventresultdetails_in) == 0 or EventResultDetails in~ (eventresultdetails_in))
+  | extend ValidatedHostname = iff(HostName matches regex @"^[a-zA-Z0-9-]{1,61}$", HostName, "")
